text:
Carmen (PM): Heads-up: quick design review for a "review gate preview" in the regression diff list. Idea: surface a tiny pass/fail indicator per-test based on current scorecard thresholds so reviewers can triage without opening each scorecard. Mock: https://figma.com/file/gate-preview
Noel (Design): Love the idea. UX concerns: small indicators could be ambiguous. Proposal: use a three-state chip: Pass / Warning / Fail with accessible label and hover tooltip that shows the contributing metric and delta. Keep the chip compact to avoid visual noise.
Zoe (Frontend): Implementation: we'll fetch per-test gate status from a summary endpoint to avoid heavy payloads. Virtualize the list and lazy-load tooltips. Also recommend caching statuses for 30s to reduce flicker during rapid actions.
Hassan (A11y): Accessibility: chips must include text (not just color) and have aria-label like "Pass: accuracy +1.2%". Tooltips should be keyboard-focusable and rendered in DOM (not just on hover). Announce state changes via an aria-live region when a bulk re-eval completes.
Rita (QA): For approval workflows: if a reviewer bulk-approves, we should block if any selected test is in Warning/Fail state. Instead show a modal listing failing tests and allow override with a mandatory comment and reason. Also flag flaky tests separately.
Carmen (PM): Good. Copy for override modal: Title = "Override failing tests"; CTA = "Approve anyway"; secondary = "Cancel". We should require a short justification when overriding.
Noel (Design): I'll add small breakouts for the chip: icon + short text (e.g., "Fail -1.8%") and a lighter outline for Warning. On hover the tooltip will show baseline/candidate numbers and the rule that failed.
Zoe (Frontend): Backend: endpoint /runs/:id/gate-summary -> [{test_id, status, delta, rule_reason, flaky}]. ETA: 3 days for proto. Frontend: prototype in 5 days with virtualization + tooltip. We'll show optimistic updates when scorecards change, then reconcile.
Hassan (A11y): Keyboard shortcuts: when focused on a row, pressing g should open the gate tooltip/panel. Ensure tooltip is focus-trapped while open and Escape closes. Add tests for VoiceOver and NVDA announcing the modal and aria-live updates for bulk operations.
Rita (QA): Edge cases: tests that cross threshold exactly (e.g., -2.00%) should be included in Warning by default. Also ensure long tooltips are truncated and have a "view full details" link that opens the detailed scorecard.
build-bot: preview deployed -> https://preview.redwood.ai/runs/1787654321/gate-preview; branch -> github.com/redwood/repo/pull/601
Carmen (PM): Plan: Noel + Zoe to ship chip + tooltip prototype, Hassan write a11y checklist, Rita create test cases for override flow. We'll review in next product crit. Thanks all! :sparkles:
